mechanism_fidelity.rationale: The mapping retains competing explanations, discriminating tests, evidence-based revision, and bounded narrowing without premature commitment. It also retains relevant limits concerning incomplete hypotheses, test sensitivity, uninformative evidence, and generalization.

target_fidelity.rationale: Crossing configuration and load on r1 can distinguish a cache-policy flag effect from load variation within replay. The r2 comparison can further distinguish the stated A-confined and B-containing explanations when contrasts are informative. This provides a bounded contribution to the original causal question without claiming a unique internal mechanism.

operational_coherence.rationale: The resettable replay supports controlled configuration and load comparisons. Since r1 contains A and B while r2 contains A but not B, their configuration contrasts can discriminate the listed deployment explanations under the calibrated additive model and measurement bound. The procedure requires six endpoint trials and two analysis passes, within budget; later investigation is explicitly deferred.

validity.rationale: The candidate preserves differential diagnosis and applies an operationally supported procedure to the retained question. Its inference is appropriately bounded by diagnostic discrimination and replay scope; actual results are needed to favor an explanation, but are not required to establish the validity of this procedure.

uncertainty: Replay outcomes are not supplied, so no explanation can currently be favored or eliminated.
Small contrasts may be indistinguishable within the stated measurement error; low-load r2 tests may not discriminate effects present only at high load.
The hypothesis set may omit causes, and replay findings may not generalize to every live workload.
